notes.title: Release Date 0.9
notes.notes:
Hello, release date for 0.9 is:
July 21st at 6pm GMT+2Changelog
- 13 new lewd events

- New stages for Private Meeting, Premium Service

- New flirt interactions

- Animated some of the flirt interactions

- Flirt UI updated

- Flirt interactions/positions are now unlocked through corruption goal completion

- Flirt tips progress now loops around; multiple tips can be triggered in one flirt turn

- New corruption goals

- When a client's preference is not known, the value on the inspector is set to 0 to avoid confusion + log alert when you learn their preference

- Taking a bath now provides an XP buff

- Text box opacity can now be set in the config menu

- You can no longer use the escape key to dismiss a menu critical to progression

- Fixed warping issue when using the skip button

- You can select where the opponent cums during Premium Service 5

- Fixed some renders in Bar Peeping

- Moved bath interaction to a submenu

- Event titles are now properly localized

- Fixed some meshes in Limping Duck, added new background room

- You can speed up physics simulation in the dice poker game

- Removed gold cap per client, replaced with an erosion mechanic

- More

notes.title: Release Date 0.8
notes.notes:
Release date for the 0.8 version of Corruption Town is: 

March 12th 6pm CET

Changelog 0.8.0
- New events (10 lewd events)
- New drunk defeat interactions
- New mini game
- New private meeting stage
- Private meeting event now gives gold on completion
- Skill Tree Changes:
    - "Customer Satisfaction Survey" and "Barmaid Sixth Sense" skills have been merged.
    - "Spike Drink" and "Anaphrodisiac Potion" skills have been removed; you no longer need these skills to use the potions from Gideon's Shop.
    - Skill Tree will be reset upon loading saves from the previous version (0.7i or before).
- STEAM: New achievement for completing the recollection gallery, achievement for completing all achievements, new story achievement.
- Change to the versioning pattern from 0.8a to 0.8.1.
- Events condition preview available from the corruption journal, so you aren't surprised when you don't meet the requirements for a specific event after an activity.
- Fixed crash when loading a save with a script that shows a day recap.
- Fixed localization pluralization issue.
- tweak and bugfixes, blabla
